features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
My Media: favorite stations, your shows, audiobooks, playlists and history, filtered by kind
Episodes newest or oldest first, filtered by unplayed, in progress or played, with show notes
Per-show skip intro and outro, speed, and new episodes added to Up next automatically
Playlists, repeat one or all, shuffle, and a reorderable Up next
Resume anywhere, chapter progress, bookmarks with notes, sleep timer and keyboard shortcuts
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
TEND Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.3.0: Episodes sort newest or oldest first and filter by unplayed, in progress or played; per-show skip intro, skip outro, speed and auto-add to Up next; playlists; repeat one or all; shuffle Up next; audiobook shelf, chapter progress, bookmark notes, mark as finished and start over.
